purpose: Interactive live engagement module for presentations, polls, quizzes, whiteboards, and real-time student participation

structure.api/: REST API endpoints (session.php, poll.php, quiz.php, activity.php, guest_auth.php)
structure.models/: Domain models (BaseModel, SessionModel, PollModel, QuizModel, etc.)

common_500_error_scenarios.cause: UNILIS_ACCESS constant not defined before requiring database_helper.php
common_500_error_scenarios.fix: Ensure UNILIS_ACCESS is defined in BaseModel constructor before requiring database_helper.php
common_500_error_scenarios.status: FIXED - Added constant check in BaseModel constructor

common_500_error_scenarios.cause: Global $conn not available or config/db.php not loaded
common_500_error_scenarios.fix: Ensure config/db.php is loaded before bootstrap.php, check database credentials

common_500_error_scenarios.cause: Database installer not run or tables not created
common_500_error_scenarios.fix: Run database/install.php to create all required tables

common_500_error_scenarios.cause: Web server cannot write to upload directories
common_500_error_scenarios.fix: Set proper write permissions (755 or 777) on upload directories

common_500_error_scenarios.cause: Class namespace doesn't match file structure or file doesn't exist
common_500_error_scenarios.fix: Ensure class files exist and namespace matches directory structure

common_500_error_scenarios.cause: Session already started by root app causing conflict
common_500_error_scenarios.fix: Bootstrap checks session_status() before starting session

common_500_error_scenarios.cause: CSRF token not included in POST requests
common_500_error_scenarios.fix: Include le_csrf_token in all state-changing requests

common_500_error_scenarios.cause: User not authenticated when accessing protected pages
common_500_error_scenarios.fix: Ensure user is logged in via UNILIS authentication before accessing ?page= routes

debugging_steps: 2. Enable error display temporarily: Add error_reporting(E_ALL); ini_set('display_errors', 1); to index.php
3. Verify database connection: Check if $conn is available in global scope
4. Check database tables: Run SHOW TABLES LIKE 'live_%' to verify tables exist
5. Verify file permissions: Ensure upload directories are writable
6. Check bootstrap loading: Verify bootstrap.php is included without errors
7. Test autoloader: Try instantiating a model class directly
8. Check API endpoints: Test api/session.php?action=list directly
9. Verify session: Check if $_SESSION['user_id'] is set
10. Check CSRF token: Verify le_csrf_token exists in session

configuration_checks.config/db.php: Must define global $conn with mysqli connection
configuration_checks.config/module.php: Must return array with module configuration
configuration_checks.config/database_helper.php: Must have UNILIS_ACCESS defined before loading
configuration_checks..htaccess: Must allow module access and prevent direct config access

quick_test.step5: Check browser console for JavaScript errors
quick_test.step6: Check network tab for failed API requests
